text:
Sam: hi team, first-day onboarding PR is blocked. GH shows the PR checks are pending forever and Buildkite says it started but then nothing updates on the PR. not sure who to ping for webhook / status perms. :wave:

Jonah: welcome Sam! quick Q: do you see any failure in the Buildkite job itself or just missing status on GitHub?

Sam: Buildkite web UI shows the job started and then the step that posts commit status failed with a 401. Buildkite log snippet:

```
Posting commit status to GitHub failed: 401 Unauthorized - webhook: signature verification failed
```

Sam: on GitHub the PR still shows "Required — waiting for status checks" and i can't merge.

Claire: that sounds like the webhook secret Buildkite uses to sign status updates doesn't match the secret configured on the GitHub side. If the webhook signature is invalid, GitHub ignores the request and Buildkite sees a 401. Also check if the Buildkite GitHub App is installed for that repo or if the pipeline is using a stale deploy key.

buildkite-bot: Pipeline "platform-cli/onboard" build #21 started. Step: post_status -> failed (401 - signature mismatch)

Jonah: @Claire can you check the app/webhook config? I also want to call out another possibility: our branch protection requires both "buildkite/status" and "github-actions" checks. If Buildkite can't post statuses, the PR will remain blocked even if Actions succeeded.

Claire: looking now. Repo is platform-cli. The Buildkite app is installed but webhook listed a secret value that doesn't match the one in Buildkite's pipeline settings (someone rotated it last month). There's also a deploy key listed but its title shows "rotated-2025-rotate".

Sam: ah ok. how do we fix it? I'm new so i can watch but won't be able to change org webhooks.

Jonah: steps: 1) org admin updates the webhook secret on the GitHub repo to match the one in Buildkite (or vice versa). 2) if the pipeline uses a deploy key, we need to ensure it's the current key and not expired/rotated. 3) re-run the Buildkite step to post status. I'll request the app admin now.

git-bot: Note: Org policy requires SSO reauthorization for third-party apps after team membership changes. Make sure the app is authorized in your SSO session.

Claire: requested webhook secret sync and rotated deploy key replacement. Also noticed the GH workflow uses a reusable workflow from org infra that requires additional permissions (workflow_call) and needs a maintainer to approve it for first-run. So GH Actions might be stuck waiting for that approval too. This is two related but distinct blockers.

Sam: oh yikes. i did use a reusable workflow template from infra/actions. i think that's flagged as requiring approval for first-run. who can approve that?

Jonah: a repo admin or someone in the "ci-maintainers" team can approve the workflow run from the Actions tab. i'll ping @Claire and @ops to approve once webhook is fixed.

buildkite-bot: Build #21: post_status retry after secret sync started.

Sam: after the webhook sync Buildkite retried and I see a 200 in the Buildkite UI for the status post, but the PR still shows pending.

Claire: give it a minute — GitHub can take a few seconds to reconcile. Also double-check that the status context matches what branch protection expects (names must match exactly).

Jonah: good point. our branch protection expects "buildkite/platform-cli" as the check name. older pipeline posted "buildkite/status" when the pipeline used the generic plugin. I updated the pipeline status context to match the branch protection.

Sam: ok I see Buildkite status now on the PR (green). GH Actions however is waiting for approval for the reusable workflow. i clicked "Approve and run" in the Actions tab but it says only repo admins can approve.

Claire: i approved the reusable workflow run and re-ran the Action. It started and picked up secrets. Note: if you're in a new SSO session you might need to reauthorize the Buildkite GitHub App too; i reauthorized on your behalf.

git-bot: Action run started: reusable-workflow -> in_progress.

Sam: both Buildkite and GH Actions are running now and posting statuses. buildkite-bot: Build #21 passed. GH Action passed. PR shows all checks green. :tada:

Jonah: summary for docs/onboarding/ci.md: 1) If PR checks are stuck, check webhook signature / webhook secret mismatch between Buildkite and GitHub. 2) Confirm the Buildkite GitHub App is installed and deploy keys are current (rotations can break things). 3) Ensure status check contexts in pipeline settings exactly match branch protection names. 4) Reusable workflows and some org-level actions require a repo admin to approve first run. 5) SSO reauthorization sometimes needed after team membership changes.

Sam: thanks everyone, huge help. would love a quick walkthrough of the webhook and status naming bits tomorrow. :coffee:
